---
title: "VS Code view"
format: html
filters:
  - git-sandbox
---

```git-sandbox
id: in-vscode
title: Commit from VS Code
prompt: "~/sales-analysis $"
vscode: true
seed: |
  git init
  echo "# Sales analysis" > README.md
  git add .
  git commit -m "Add the README"
  echo "x <- 1" > analysis.R
tasks:
  - text: Stage `analysis.R`
    when: staged
  - text: Commit it
    when: commits >= 2
```

```git-sandbox
id: plain
title: A box without the VS Code view
```
